title: Field-interaction pair for Read and Write
purpose: Cover both data retrieval and data modification parser paths using two distinct confirmed services with stable framing.
expected_behavior: Server accepts two separate confirmed-service parses, first for read semantics and then for write semantics, yielding normal response, rejection, or application-specific handling.
constraints_preserved: TPKT version byte is 0x03 on both messages
TPKT total-length fields match each complete 25-byte message
ACSE/UserInformation framing is preserved consistently across both operations
Service-choice tags [4] and [5] match supplied Read and Write catalog entries
Read and Write are both listed in the supplied recommended initial seed services
issue_safety_notes: Safe coverage seed pair only; requests are minimal conservative analogues and do not embed aggressive values, oversized elements, or malformed writes.
